grades.reason: Exercise fragments about free, standby and modified page lists. They say nothing about TLB misses or how a miss differs from paging data in from disk.

grades.quote: TLB refill exception: This exception is triggered when the virtual address of an access operation does not have a match in the TLB, which notifies the system software to perform a TLB refill.
grades.reason: The passage says a TLB miss raises a TLB refill exception, which only asks system software to refill the TLB. It treats this as separate from page-invalid exceptions, which occur when a matching entry has V=0. That separation implies a miss is a translation-cache refill and not necessarily a disk read. It never mentions disk or page-in, so it covers only part of the answer.
